mapper.select: SELECT r.*,b.title book_title,rd.real_name reader_name FROM borrow_record r JOIN book b ON r.book_id=b.id JOIN reader rd ON r.reader_id=rd.id WHERE (#{readerId} IS NULL OR r.reader_id=#{readerId}) ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE (#{readerId} IS NULL OR reader_id=#{readerId})
SELECT r.*,b.title book_title,rd.real_name reader_name FROM borrow_record r JOIN book b ON r.book_id=b.id JOIN reader rd ON r.reader_id=rd.id WHERE r.reader_id=#{readerId} ORDER BY r.borrow_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalBorrowCount,COALESCE(SUM(status=1),0) AS activeBorrowCount,COALESCE(SUM(status=4 OR (status=1 AND due_time IS NOT NULL AND due_time < NOW())),0) AS overdueCount,COALESCE(SUM(status IN (2,3)),0) AS returnedCount FROM borrow_record

SELECT b.title,b.author,COUNT(r.id) AS borrowCount,b.available_stock AS availableStock FROM borrow_record r JOIN book b ON r.book_id=b.id GROUP BY b.id,b.title,b.author,b.available_stock ORDER BY borrowCount DESC LIMIT 8
mapper.update: UPDATE borrow_record SET return_time=#{returnTime},status=#{status},remark=#{remark} WHERE id=#{id} AND status=1
